attempts.summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 for key-based SSH access with the specified ed25519 public key and enforced key-only SSH authentication cluster-wide. Along the way discovered and fixed two latent issues that had completely disabled sshd on this node: missing host keys and a missing /run/sshd privilege-separation directory with no tmpfiles.d rule to recreate it — the latter would have re-broken SSH on every future reboot, so a persistent tmpfiles rule was added. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured a healthy baseline, performed a native reboot, confirmed the boot ID changed, and verified SSH, the opsadmin account, and the key-only auth policy all recovered post-restart, including a live SSH protocol handshake.
